fixes.explanation: Nope, friend. The anger of the LORD turned away from Rehoboam because he humbled himself, and He did not destroy him completely (2 Chronicles 12:12). I know, I know, it's tempting to picture the anger swinging over to Shishak like a hot pan handed to the next guy. But this verse never hands it off. The text just says it turned away from Rehoboam.

No priests of Jeroboam in this verse, friend. The writer keeps it short: “And Rehoboam did evil because he did not set his heart to seek the LORD.” (2 Chronicles 12:14) No villain whispering in his ear, no outside push. I'll tell you, that one sentence hits harder than a whole page of excuses, baker.
